fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM86,810. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0003080/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass STPM or equivalent with at least Grade C (CGPA 2.0) in 2 subjects; OR Pass STAM (level Jayyid); OR Pass UEC with at least Grade B in 5 subjects; OR Pass Matriculation/Foundation with at least CGPA of 2.00 from 4.00; OR Minimum pass of 3 subjects in A-Level (GCE); OR Minimum score of 65-75% for The South Australian Matriculation (AUSMAT); OR Minimum score of 80% for Canadian Pre-University Programmes (CPU); OR Diploma in related field with a minimum CGPA of 2.00; OR Any other qualifications recognized as equivalent. English Requirements (International Students): TOEFL score of 500 or IELTS score of 5.0 or equivalent.
